children: Hong Kong healthcare services provider's fiscal yr revenue fell 1.4% yr/yr
Net loss attributable to owners widened to HK$74.6 mln from prior yr profit
Company's performance impacted by uneven corporate spending and clinic rationalisation
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or upcoming year
CORPORATE SPENDING - Co said uneven corporate spending sentiment in Hong Kong, Macau and Chinese Mainland weighed on performance
CLINIC RATIONALISATION - Co said clinic rationalisation and rebranding in Hong Kong affected segment performance
FOSHAN START-UP COSTS - Adjusted EBITDA fell 21% to HK$75.2 mln as the new Foshan integrated healthcare centre incurred start-up and ramp-up costs
